item.title: Former Miss Missouri Selected To Lead Main Street Chillicothe
item.description: The new Executive Director of Main Street Chillicothe is McKinsie Saunders, formerly McKinsie Garber of Chillicothe. Saunders brings extensive experience in community leadership, financial management, event planning, and strategic communications from her history with various national and regional organizations. item.title: Ambulance Board Filing
item.description: Another name was added to the April Municipal Election ballot on Friday. Ken Lauhoff filed to serve on the Ambulance District Board. Filing for the April Municipal Election continues through December 30th.

item.title: Dekalb County DWI Arrest
item.description: State Troopers arrested a Gallatin woman Friday evening in Dekalb County. 41-year-old Kristen Milum of Gallatin was charged with alleged DWI. She was processed and held at the Daviess Dekalb Regional Jail.
